name: opencivicquery-sfgov
description: Live answers from San Francisco's city website, SF.gov: agency news, meeting pages with the files attached to them, such as minutes, page and document titles, and the text of a news or meeting page, each with evidence a reporter can cite.
long_description:
OpenCivicQuery's SF.gov tools, run on your own computer. They read the content interface behind www.sf.gov directly, so answers are live and cover every agency on the site.

- **find_sfgov_news** lists an agency's news pages in a date range.
- **find_sfgov_meetings** lists a board's or commission's meeting pages in a date range, with the files attached to each page, such as minutes, and video links.
- **search_sfgov** finds pages by words in the title, or files in SF.gov's document library.
- **get_sfgov_page** returns the text of one news or meeting page.

Every answer carries warnings, presentation rules, and an evidence snapshot saved on this computer under ~/.opencivicquery/snapshots; pin_snapshot and get_snapshot keep and read them.

tools.name: find_sfgov_news
tools.description: List an SF.gov agency's news pages in a date range, newest first.

tools.name: find_sfgov_meetings
tools.description: List a San Francisco body's meeting pages in a date range, with attached files and video links.

tools.name: search_sfgov
tools.description: Find SF.gov pages by words in the title, or files in its document library.

tools.name: get_sfgov_page
tools.description: Return the text of one SF.gov news or meeting page.

tools.name: pin_snapshot
tools.description: Keep an answer's evidence snapshot so it is not deleted.

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Read back the rows and warnings an evidence snapshot froze.
